title: Reviewed MCP tools
intro: Allow selected tools for manual OpenAI-compatible managed text runs. Every exact tool call pauses for your approval. This is not unattended automation.
enabled: Selected tools enabled for manual review
discovery_help: Discovery reads the attached connections’ tool catalogs. It does not execute tools. Only bounded object schemas are supported. Changing a model, connection, bundle or catalog requires review again.
policy_consent: I reviewed these tools. Each call will still require my approval of its exact destination and arguments. Incoming events and schedules cannot use this tool policy.
saved: Tool policy saved. Previous reviews are retired.
unavailable: Tool settings changed or are unavailable. Reload and review again.
bundle_edit: Editing this bundle disables its tool policy. Review and enable selected tools again afterwards.
tools_manual_warning: Each proposed tool call requires a separate approval of its exact destination and arguments. Manual runs only; no scheduled or incoming-event execution.
tool_effect_warning: This external tool can change data or cause other effects. Only approve arguments you understand. Stopping the run or a failed response does not undo an action already attempted.
tool_exact_consent: I approve this exact tool, destination and arguments once.
tool_approved: Call approved. Refresh the run history for its outcome.
